notes.title: The Announcement Of Unfortunate Tales Of Violet!
notes.content:
Howdy!

We are Crab 9, the developers of Unfortunate Tales Of Violet. We are trying to create a unique experince for who likes to make spells. And today is the first announcement trailer. We hope you to enjoy!


[previewyoutube=wjmfAB-aNzU;full][/previewyoutube]

You can jump in to our discussions on Steam or join our Discord to stay in contact with the team. Stay hydrated!
